tips.li: Goblins are small and fragile, but combat pheromones make a clustered force more dangerous.
Hobgoblins are rare elite fighters. Give them better equipment and command roles.
A goblin squad leader anchors the squad's morale. Eliminating one can quickly rout that squad.
Goblins can butcher humanlike corpses for human bones and useful body parts.
Leaving flesh craving unattended harms a goblin's mood, consciousness, and movement.
Goblin cuisine makes efficient use of organs and body parts.
Goblins resist toxic environments, but they are poor farmers. Plan food production accordingly.
A goblin beacon burns goblin corpses to call the attention of other goblins.
Beacon ritual quality affects the scale and character of the goblins that answer the signal.
A goblin beacon may attract hostile attention as well as friendly visitors.
Slave marriage is a goblin group ritual that binds the master side and the slave side together.
By default, goblin slave marriage requires pheromone adaptation. This condition can be changed in mod settings.
Slave marriage creates a concubine relationship separate from formal marriage.
Central tunnel raids open clustered tunnels within one attack area.
Living tunnels send reinforcements over time. Destroy them before the next wave arrives.
Large tunnels carry more troops and reinforce for longer than normal tunnels.
Goblin mortar raids build a field position and prepare bombardment. Cutting off supply tunnels weakens a long siege.
Boomstick sappers use explosives to breach walls. Narrow corridors are especially dangerous.
When defenders fall at a goblin base, defensive tunnels may activate.
Goblin ambushes can strike caravans on the world map. Be especially careful near hostile goblin settlements.
Special weapons can appear as rare squad leader loot, quest rewards, or ideology relics.
Goblin sculptures support Children of Blinia ideology rituals.
Pure goblins grow quickly. Newborn goblins become useful manpower soon after birth.
Thin goblins suit cheap labor and numbers. Hobgoblins are better suited to elite roles.
